measuring evenly BEFORE having a theory is the one thing a campaign cannot go back and do. In a controlled comparison on a real library, evidence chosen evenly gave belief posteriors that were right 67% of the time while asserting 0.77; evidence chosen to maximise the objective was right 23% while asserting 0.76. theories.statement: context-first 入口: 新颖可编程系统藏在移动元件/转座子/IS 语境里的孤儿效应蛋白旁——但 novelty check 证明 MGE 邻接 + 全长催化折叠产出的候选全是已知核酸酶(细胞 RuvC 解离酶/HNH), 零 novel, 所以此入口单独不足, 需要 guide 共进化或结构 novelty 作正交第二信号。
ncRNA-first 入口: 新颖系统藏在"有保守非编码 RNA 与效应蛋白共定位"的 locus——guide 与效应蛋白共进化是 RNA-guided 系统最硬的信号, 且不需要预设 canonical CRISPR array 或切割活性。

theories.note: its directional claims earned no weight — the data does not move the way this mechanism says it should
theories.statement: structure-first 入口: 序列发散但结构类似核酸酶/RNA 结合折叠的孤儿蛋白——用结构比对而非序列 BLAST 作种子, 才能抓到趋同进化出的、序列上完全陌生的催化折叠。CasX 与 TIGR-Tas 的 Nop 域都是 sequence-level distant 但 structure-level 类似。
architecture-first 修正版: 全长催化折叠覆盖(--domtblout)是必要不充分条件——novelty check 证明全长覆盖的 RuvC 折叠可能是细胞 crossover junction endonuclease(管家), HNH 全长覆盖可能是 homing endonuclease, 都不是效应器。

novel 可编程效应器不会在 nr 里命中已知核酸酶/解离酶(pident>=30%)——novelty check 显示 context-first 产出的 22 个全长催化折叠候选全部命中细胞 RuvC 解离酶/HNH 核酸酶/HTH(21 known + 1 hole), 零 novel。RuvC 折叠是陷阱: 细胞 ruvC 基因(crossover junction endonuclease)本身全长覆盖 RuvC 域。novelty_status=hole 是 novel 候选的必要条件(非充分, §0: hole≠novel)。

candidates.label: v1_adjacent_unit
candidates.program: sliding window over unit length L in 23..50 step 5; ident[i] = match(window[i], window[i+L])/L; good = ident in [0.70,1.0]; walk contiguous good runs; copies = run+1; require copies>=3 and span>=69.

candidates.label: v2_period_spaced_step5

candidates.label: v3_period_spaced_step1
candidates.rationale: Same as v2 but unit step 1. Tests the true L but still 0/2: a spaced repeat has contiguous high-identity positions only over the motif length (~11 nt of each 66-nt period), so a contiguous-run walk breaks before reaching 3 copies.

candidates.label: v4_period_spaced_jitter
candidates.rationale: v3 plus +/-1 jitter on the period to tolerate spacer drift (measured spacer gaps 65/66/67 nt). Still 0/2 and 10x slower: jitter widens the good window but the contiguous-run flaw remains — motif identity is ~1.0 at repeat positions but falls to ~0.28 mid-spacer.

candidates.label: v5_seed_gap
candidates.program: build dict of every 12-mer's occurrence positions; for each mer with >=min_copies occurrences, cluster sorted positions by roughly-constant gap g in [unit_min+spacer_min, unit_max+spacer_max] (gap within +/-1 of running period); copies = gaps+1; P = mean(gaps); extend each occurrence left/right while >=60% of copies agree to get motif length L; pairwise identity over full motif; dedupe overlapping hits keeping max copies.
candidates.rationale: Clusters a 12-mer's occurrences by roughly-constant gap (the true period), then extends each occurrence to measure motif length and pairwise identity. Recovers 2/2: S. thermophilus L=36 period 66 copies 34 (literature repeat GTTTTTGTACTCTCAAGATTTAAGTAACTGTACAAC, 33 copies); E. coli period 61.

campaign.goal: Branch E 全域扫描：用已验证的 v4 检测器（正对照两档 + 假阳性对照 + 每基因组命中率上界都齐）在病毒/MGE 基因组（GPD 142,809 条）上做 repeat-array-first 扫描，拿到阵列后问邻近蛋白，晋升判据是"阵列+邻接蛋白家族"跨类群共保守（≥5 基因组、≥2 属）。目的是在 DNA 层补上任务书 §4 缺失的独立入口，使 §12 的"entry mechanisms 足够多样"第一次真正成立。
campaign.objective_falsified_by: n_promoted 若为 0 不能说明没有候选，只能说明"阵列+邻接蛋白跨类群共保守"这一判据没触发。真正的反面证据是：扫描覆盖了病毒/MGE 域的代表性样本、阵列检测在正对照上召回正常、但没有任何一个阵列的邻接蛋白在 ≥2 属里共保守——那才算 DNA 层入口的诚实阴性。若 n_promoted>0 但邻接蛋白全在 nr/swissprot 命中已知家族，则晋升判据本身选错了东西。
